checks.evidence: The first complete request uses task with the two generic name selectors A and B and requests closed_solid_relation plus surface_proximity.
More candidates are handled by querying each relevant pair; no unsupported multi-pair array is advertised.
The objects description says each exact selector contains name OR id, separately from the number of selectors. The unchanged SELECTOR_SCHEMA oneOf enforces that choice.
aabb remains 1..4 selectors, while pair facts explicitly require exactly two ordered A to B.
Exactly one target is scoped to global surface_nearest, rather than incorrectly applied to task pair facts.
surface_nearest documents one query.objects selector without focal_id.
The alternative known focal_id with query containing only mode is documented, with session_id and include_image=false required.
Complete global nearest and partial best-known are distinguished, avoiding a global-completeness claim for partial output.
The fact description retains represented connected closed triangle shells at zero tolerance and separated/touching/penetrating classifications.
Penetrating is stated to mean positive-volume interior overlap, independently of surface distance.
Invalid or ambiguous geometry is explicitly unknown with reasons; no universal measurement promise is made.
surface_proximity remains an independent nonnegative triangle-surface distance with original world points, positive-distance A-to-B direction, and boundary/nonmanifold counts.
Zero-distance direction is not applicable, and edge counts do not certify solids. Missing/unknown quantity guidance allows retained known quantities to remain useful.
pair_relation retains separation gap/points/direction, touching, and certified escape translation of A, with escape distinguished from surface distance, nearest direction, and minimum depth.

overview/exact_pairs/nearest/top1 remain named. object_ids and max_exact_pairs guidance is scoped to legacy exact_pairs/nearest/top1; complete exact nonpenetrating nearest and strict-bound top1 ties remain accurate.
Unchanged operation/task_ref/include_image descriptions retain registered single-target mesh_structure and local opt-in mesh_surface guidance, original budgets, references and preview-only behavior.
The observe description retains scene_revision/fingerprint, source identity, trace diagnostics and expiration after scene changes.

Complete current measurements may be used to answer, while missing/unknown quantities call for additional evidence using their reasons. No forced trust or prohibition on native verification is introduced.
The request uses only generic A/B names and read-1 session label; no fixture identity, shape, measurement, expected classification or answer is present.
The candidate makes no claim of actual model adoption, faster successful task completion, token saving or distrust; those remain unmeasured.
Transform, connection status and clearance segment descriptions remain unchanged in the inspected diff.
